queries_run: AMD go-to-market change distribution channel business model 2026 rack-scale platform

findings.claim: AMD 10-K FY2025 稱其日益聚焦 VAR 通路（轉售 OEM 系統給中型與 SMB 市場）及全球系統整合商；銷售仍經直銷、OEM、獨立經銷商。
findings.excerpt: Large multi-nationals and regional accounts are the core of our OEM partners’ business; however, we are increasingly focused on the VAR channel, which resells OEM systems to the mid-market and the small and medium business (SMB) segments.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要稱 AMD 由單賣 GPU/CPU 轉向整機櫃（rack-scale）系統，Lisa Su 預期 2026 年 MI450 絕大多數以整機櫃方案銷售。
findings.source: letsdatascience 等聚合站報導（AMD Shifts To Rack-Scale Systems Strategy）
findings.excerpt: In 2026 it expects the "vast majority" of its MI450 series GPUs to be sold as "rack scale solutions"

note: as_of 為推估；rack-scale 來源為聚合站，未讀頁面。
